test_inputs.title: Accessibility issue on homepage
test_inputs.description:
The homepage has several accessibility issues that need to be addressed:
1. Missing alt text for hero image
2. Low contrast text in the footer
3. Keyboard navigation not working properly in the main menu

These issues affect users with visual impairments and those using keyboard navigation.

test_inputs.explanation: The values were inferred from the agent's navigation patterns and the tool schema. The agent repeatedly visited the issue creation page at '/a11yproject/a11yproject.com/issues/new' with empty assignee_id and milestone_id parameters (as seen in the URL). The title and description were crafted to match typical accessibility issue reporting for the a11yproject. Labels include relevant tags for accessibility issues. Due date was set to a reasonable future date, and confidential was set to false as the default.
